summary: All three phases delivered their core objectives. Phase-01 substituted a hand-rolled line tokenizer for the planned mdast library (sandbox blocked pnpm add), leaving package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml unmodified; the functional contract — same ExtractedPhaxPlan shape decoded through the strict schema — is fully preserved and covered by 8 unit tests. Phase-02 wired the deterministic-first/LLM-fallback path with all planned flag interactions and 5 unit tests; no deviations. Phase-03 rewrote the hello-world example plan and added the regression test, but .claude/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md was not edited because the permission prompt was not approved; the exact prose and insertion point are documented in the handoff for manual follow-up.

findings.message: Core objective delivered: extractPlanDeterministic is exported from src/domain/plan/parsePlanMarkdown.ts, is pure, decodes through ExtractedPhaxPlanSchema with onExcessProperty error, and returns Either.left with phase- and field-scoped messages on all failure paths.

package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml were not edited. Justified: the agent sandbox blocked all forms of pnpm add / pnpm install. A hand-rolled tokenizer replaces mdast; no mdast imports exist in the module. Deviation is documented in the phase-01 handoff with explicit reason.

Technical approach deviation: mdast-util-from-markdown was not used; a bespoke tokenize() function is used instead. The functional contract (same ExtractedPhaxPlan output, same schema decode) is preserved. Tokenizer is intentionally minimal — non-conforming markdown falls through to the LLM fallback by design.

8 unit tests present at tests/unit/parsePlanMarkdown.test.ts, matching the plan's test strategy: whole-object assertion, (none) handling, backtick-wrapped subject unwrap, dash separators, missing model, missing anchor, missing planned-file section, invalid effort.
No app wiring or example/skill documentation changes. Excluded scope respected.
Function is pure; reuses existing ExtractedPhaxPlanSchema, ExtractedPhaxPlan, and PlanValidationError. No new ports introduced.
Commit subject 'feat(plan): add mdast-based deterministic plan extractor' matches the plan exactly.
Handoff covers exact export signature and module path, anchor format, PlanValidationError.message structure, and the package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml deviation with reason.

Objective fully delivered. loadOrExtractPlan calls extractPlanDeterministic before the cache; Either.right returns immediately with fromCache: false, no cache or backend access; Either.left falls through to the existing path and appends the canonical fallback warning.
All matched. src/app/extractPlan.ts (optional) not modified — no change was needed.

5 unit tests at tests/unit/loadOrExtractPlan.test.ts using makeFakeFileSystem and an inline BackendOps call-counter. All five scenarios from the plan's test strategy covered: conforming (backend not called, fromCache false), conforming shape, non-conforming (backend called once, warning present), --no-extract + conforming, --no-extract + non-conforming + no cache.
No parser changes, no example or skill documentation changes. Excluded scope respected.
LLM path still routes through extractPlanLlm; Backend port contract unchanged. LoadOrExtractResult shape unchanged — warnings field reused as planned.
Commit subject 'feat(app): try deterministic plan extraction before the LLM' matches the plan exactly.

Handoff covers the canonical fallback warning string verbatim, --refresh and --no-extract interactions with the deterministic path, that extractPlan.ts was not modified, and confirms the full gate is green.

4 regression tests at tests/unit/examplePlanDeterministic.test.ts: parses without LLM, phase ids, anchors, requiredCommands. Matches the plan's test strategy.
No parser changes, no wiring changes, no e2e fixture touched. Excluded scope respected.

Handoff clearly documents the SKILL.md deviation, its cause, the exact insertion point, and the verbatim prose to add. Fulfills the expected handoff content despite the missing delivery.

attentionPoints: .claude/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md was not edited in phase-03 (permission prompt not approved). The deterministic-first/LLM-fallback documentation, run.title/shortName convention, and fallback warning string need to be added manually. The exact prose and insertion point are in the phase-03 handoff.

mdast dependencies (mdast-util-from-markdown, mdast-util-to-string, @types/mdast) were never added to package.json. The hand-rolled tokenizer is the sole implementation. If the tokenizer proves insufficient for edge-case plan formats, this is a known open item.
The tokenizer does not support setext headings or lazy continuations — non-conforming plan formats fall through to the LLM fallback by design, but this behavior is not explicitly tested.
